Special Screening in Rome

Nitesh Tiwari's ambitious cinematic project, Ramayana: Rise of a Legend, recently reached international audiences through a special screening held in Rome at the Pontifical Academies.

The event brought together notable attendees, including staff members of the Pontifical Academy of Sciences, Ghana's Ambassador to the Holy See, various embassy officials, and invited guests.

Cardinal Turkson's Appreciation

Peter Kodwo Turkson, the first Ghanaian cardinal and Chancellor of the Pontifical Academies of Sciences and Social Sciences, viewed the film and subsequently shared his perspectives on its narrative and cultural resonance.

He commended the visual execution, noting the complex photography and intricate imagery required to bring the grand scale of the production together.

Parallels with Biblical and Ancient Traditions

During his remarks, Cardinal Turkson drew comparisons between the themes of the Indian epic and stories found in Biblical and ancient traditions, highlighting a shared focus on the eternal struggle between good and evil.

He pointed out that the narrative foundation resembles ancient accounts of creation, noting that such mythological origins often share universal motifs across different global cultures.

Themes of Brotherhood and Devotion

The cardinal specifically addressed the relationship between Lord Rama and his younger brother Lakshman, observing how the younger sibling's steadfast protection echoes familiar familial duties found in Biblical texts.

He noted that the loyalty displayed, including the defense of family and spouse, represents a deeply resonant core value that transcends cultural boundaries.

Cast and Production Background

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the film features a star-studded cast with Ranbir Kapoor starring as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Goddess Sita, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, and Yash portraying Ravana.

The ensemble also includes Arun Govil as Dashrath, Lara Dutta as Queen Kaikeyi, and Rakul Preet Singh as Supranakha, with production handled by Namit Malhotra and a musical score crafted by A.R. Rahman and Hans Zimmer.

Global Box Office Milestones

Commercially, the feature has achieved substantial success worldwide, crossing the $100 million milestone globally during its opening week helped by the Diwali holiday period.

Trade tracking figures indicate strong continued performance in theatres following its initial debut on November 5, 2026, with a planned second installment slated for release in 2028.

News Overview

Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana received praise from Cardinal Peter Turkson after a special screening in Rome, where he highlighted its universal themes of good versus evil and brotherhood. The film continues to perform strongly at the global box office following its November 2026 release.

Reaching the Halfway Point

The Chinese drama Sunshine Through The Rain is quickly approaching the midpoint of its broadcast run. Featuring Winwin and Yang Chao Yue in the principal roles, the series adopts a popular urban romance format based on school rivals turning into lovers.

Audience interest has steadily climbed thanks to the engaging narrative and the charming chemistry between the lead characters as their story unfolds on screen.

Plot Developments and Love Triangle Tensions

The upcoming episodes will see growing complexity in the central relationships. Xie Yu Di's persistent obsession with Zheng Yu continues to create friction, while Chen Yan's romantic feelings for her begin to deepen.

An intensifying love triangle has left viewers eagerly anticipating the next turns in the plot as character dynamics shift and personal stakes rise.

Hospital Twists and Medical Revelations

Previews indicate that upcoming chapters will feature an unexpected hospital visit. After Chen Yan develops a fever from the rain, Zheng Yu accompanies him to see a doctor for medical attention.

During the consultation, a conversation about allergies reveals that Chen Yan is allergic to eggs and has been taking medication, a detail that Zheng Yu overhears and uses to suggest they spend more time understanding each other.

Confrontations and Protective Gestures

Tensions also flare when Chen Yan engages in a physical altercation with Xie Yu after sensitive details about Zheng Yu's mother are brought up in front of classmates.

Zheng Yu later tends to Chen Yan's injury and expresses her gratitude for his willingness to stand up for her against the remarks made by their schoolmate.

Schedule and Streaming Platform Details

The latest chapters are scheduled to release today on MGTV. SVIP subscribers will gain entry to Episodes 10 and 11, whereas VIP members will have access to streaming for Episodes 9 and 10.

Official releases are timed for 12:00 PM Beijing Time, which corresponds to 9:30 AM Indian Standard Time.

Alternative Viewing Options

Viewers looking for alternate access can occasionally find fan-uploaded versions featuring English subtitles on Dailymotion following the official premiere.

Fans searching for these alternative uploads typically look up specific phrases related to the episode titles to watch the subtitled content online.

ld.articleBody:
Fjord Wins Big in Jakarta

Cristian Mungiu's celebrated feature film "Fjord" secured the sole feature prize at the Jakarta World Cinema event, capturing the coveted Audience Award. The movie also had the distinct honor of opening the entire festival.

The festival concluded its successful run with a closing ceremony that celebrated international cinema alongside emerging regional talents. Attendees and organizers gathered to mark the conclusion of the multi-day cinematic celebration.

Festival Attendance and Closing Highlights

Executive director Frederica revealed that over 25,000 film enthusiasts attended screenings at CGV Grand Indonesia across the eight-day festival. The event wrapped up with the screening of Banjong Pisanthanakun's Thai horror film "Inherit."

Pisanthanakun and leading star Davika Hoorne were present for the Indonesian premiere, participating in an engaging Q&A session with fans. Discussion during the event touched upon Hoorne's elaborate wardrobe, including a high-end Gucci dress.

KlikFilm Short Movie Competition Winners

The festival's closing ceremony additionally revealed the victors of the KlikFilm Short Movie Competition, organized by the local streaming platform that supports the festival. Running from April to July, the contest attracted more than 300 short films from across Indonesia.

A panel of esteemed industry judges evaluated the submissions, featuring horror filmmaker Joko Anwar, writer-director Gina S. Noer, and short film creator Khozy Rizal.

Debut Feature Funding Rewards

The primary honor of the short movie competition went to Jusuf Witjaksono for his short "Karim." This victory grants the director full production and distribution funding for his debut feature from Falcon Pictures.

Adam Hasyim Al Raschid secured the first runner-up spot with "Air Pangea," while Ali Yafie Muzaki claimed second runner-up with "The Grave of Dreams." Both directors also secured full feature funding packages from KlikFilm.

Additional Competition Honors

Further recognition was handed out during the ceremony, with Zaky Alfawwaz taking home the short film audience award for "Callsh#t." Meanwhile, Michael Juan Saptayada earned the Special Jury Prize for his short project "OTW."

These awards highlight the festival's ongoing commitment to nurturing new voices in Indonesian cinema and providing practical pathways to full-length filmmaking.

ld.articleBody:
Judicial Ruling on Unauthorized Exploitation

The legal dispute surrounding unauthorized portrayals of prominent sports figures reached a notable milestone when the Delhi High Court delivered its verdict. The judicial body determined that the motion picture Doosra unlawfully encroached upon the personality and publicity rights of former Indian cricket captain Sourav Ganguly.

As part of its official directives, the Court mandated that the production banner Ramesh Deo Productions Private Limited must deposit a sum of Rs. 2 crores. Furthermore, the studio was instructed to integrate clear disclaimers in both Hindi and English at the commencement and conclusion of the feature film.

Origins of the Lawsuit and Legal Representation

The proceedings originated from a formal legal complaint submitted jointly by Sourav Ganguly and production company Luv Films. The plaintiffs contested the unauthorized incorporation of Ganguly's personal identity and significant biographical incidents within the cinematic narrative of the project.

Responding to the grievances raised by the petitioners, the bench enacted restrictions preventing the filmmakers from distributing or premiering Doosra across digital streaming platforms or via any alternative broadcast mediums.

Court Observations on Narrative Inseparability

During the evaluation of the case, the Court noted that specific facets of the former athlete's persona and historical life events are deeply interwoven into the core storyline of the movie. Because these references form a continuous thread throughout the plot, the bench found it practically unfeasible to excise the contested segments from the final edited version.

To balance the inclusion of these narrative elements with legal protections, the Court opted for mandatory disclaimers. These notices are designed to explicitly inform viewers of the true nature of the cinematic project without relying on structural edits to the film itself.

Mandatory Disclaimers and Non-Consent

The enforced text within the film must clearly communicate specific boundaries to the audience regarding the involvement of the retired cricket star. Specifically, the disclaimers need to state that Ganguly withheld any formal consent regarding the commercial exploitation or theatrical depiction of his likeness.

Additionally, the notices must officially clarify that the production maintains no authorized affiliation, endorsement, or official backing from the former captain, ensuring that viewers understand the independent nature of the creative work.

Broader Implications for Celebrity Rights

This high-profile ruling highlights the evolving legal challenges associated with utilizing recognizable public figures and their private histories within commercial media and motion pictures. Publicity and personality rights exist primarily to safeguard individuals from unauthorized commercial capitalization tied to their established name, image, and likeness.

The decision serves as a key legal precedent concerning the boundaries of biographical storytelling and unauthorized appropriations within the entertainment industry, stressing the importance of proper permissions when referencing living personalities.

Context of the Authorized Biopic Project

While unauthorized projects face judicial scrutiny, legitimate biographical projects centered on the sports icon continue development. An officially sanctioned biographical film titled Dada: The Sourav Ganguly Story is currently in production.

The authorized movie is slated for theatrical release on May 14, 2026. The project is directed by Vikramaditya Motwane and is backed by producers Luv Ranjan and Ankur Garg.

News Overview

The Delhi High Court has ruled that the film Doosra violated Sourav Ganguly's personality rights, ordering the makers to deposit Rs. 2 crores and display clear disclaimers. The lawsuit, filed by Ganguly and Luv Films, also blocked the movie's release on OTT platforms due to unauthorized use of his life events.

While the unauthorized project faces judicial curbs, an official biopic titled Dada: The Sourav Ganguly Story remains scheduled for release in May 2026.

An Ambitious Digital Debut

Filmmaker Sanjay Gupta was actively preparing to step into the digital streaming space prior to his sudden death on October 30, 2026. He intended to helm an eight-part episodic drama based on the true crime book titled CIU: Criminals in Uniform.

The source material for this planned adaptation was authored by investigative journalists Dr Sanjay Singh and Rakesh Trivedi. Gupta had envisioned the project as a massive undertaking for his entry into web storytelling.

A Star-Studded Cast in Discussions

According to statements shared by Dr Sanjay Singh, the director had held multiple creative meetings and put together a detailed pitch deck. The ambition driving the endeavor was to assemble one of the most prominent casts ever seen in an Indian web series.

Talks were underway with several notable actors, including Anil Kapoor, Naseeruddin Shah, Akshaye Khanna, Emraan Hashmi, Dia Mirza, Atul Kulkarni, Mahesh Manjrekar, and Ronit Bose Roy.

Envisioned Character Roles

The casting vision assigned specific prominent figures to key narrative positions within the fictionalized crime drama. Anil Kapoor was conceptualized to portray the Mumbai Police Commissioner.

Additionally, Naseeruddin Shah was considered for the role of a bureaucrat, Akshaye Khanna as an Assistant Commissioner of Police, and Emraan Hashmi as a senior inspector.

Inspired by Real-World Events

The underlying plot of the project serves as a fictionalised account stemming from the 2021 Antilia bomb scare incident. The storyline follows the controversial head of the Mumbai Police Crime Investigation Unit leading a tense investigation after explosives are discovered near a prominent tycoon's residence.

Dr Sanjay Singh noted that Gupta recognized the deep sensitivity of the subject matter while firmly believing the publication held strong potential for a captivating streaming series.

A Legacy Built on Gritty Cinema

Sanjay Gupta's expansive 32-year career in the film industry was defined by stylish action dramas and slick crime thrillers. His notable directorial credits include films such as Kaante, Zinda, Shootout at Wadala, and Kaabil.

Reflecting on his creative style, Dr Sanjay Singh emphasized that Gupta's storytelling always extended beyond the basic mechanics of crime to focus heavily on human circumstances, hidden truths, and untold perspectives.

Revisiting the Ranga-Billa Case

Aside from the CIU project, the filmmaker also harbored aspirations to revisit the historical 1978 Ranga-Billa case. Even though Prime Video had recently released a project titled Raakh exploring the same subject, Gupta felt the makers had missed a chance to explore the complete complexity of the crime.

He maintained a firm belief that tremendous scope remained for producing a powerful, factually accurate series focusing on the historical event.

Tragic Passing in Mumbai

The visionary director passed away unexpectedly on the night of October 30, 2026, at the age of 57. The incident occurred at his residence located in the Versova area of Mumbai following a fatal head injury sustained during an accidental fall.

The planned project featured discussions with prominent actors like Anil Kapoor and Naseeruddin Shah for a star-studded cast inspired by the 2021 Antilia incident.

Late-Night Celebrations in South Mumbai

While crowds of dedicated admirers gathered outside his iconic residence Mannat to catch a glimpse of the superstar on his special day, Shah Rukh Khan quietly slipped out of the premises. The actor headed toward South Mumbai to ring in his 61st birthday surrounded by his closest family and friends.

The celebration took place at a prominent luxury property, the Taj hotel, where the actor reportedly partied late into the night. Photographers captured his swanky vehicle parked outside the venue well into the early hours of Monday morning, signaling a lively gathering behind closed doors.

Family Presence at the Private Bash

Family members played a central role in the private festivities, with fan reports confirming the presence of the actor's children. Both Suhana Khan and Aryan Khan were spotted joining the birthday celebrations to support and celebrate with their father.

While the younger members made a relatively swift exit from the venue, the superstar himself lingered longer, ensuring the private event extended deep into the morning hours before his eventual departure.

Frenzy Outside the Hotel Venue

As the birthday boy finally emerged from the hotel to head home, his departure triggered an immediate frenzy among onlookers and fans stationed outside. Viral video clips captured eager supporters cheering loudly and shouting expressions of affection as he walked toward his waiting car.

Before stepping inside the vehicle, the actor took a moment to acknowledge the roaring crowd. He reciprocated the warmth by warmly waving and blowing kisses to the gathered admirers who had waited hours just to see him.

Turning Mannat Into a Giant Screen

Earlier in the day, the superstar found a unique way to connect with the massive crowds gathered outside his Mannat residence. He transformed the exterior of his home into a giant display screen to give fans an exciting preview of his upcoming professional projects.

The massive outdoor display treated onlookers to a special glimpse of his highly anticipated film 'King', featuring a new song starring the actor alongside Deepika Padukone. The innovative showcase offered a memorable visual treat for everyone present.

A Personal Note to Dedicated Fans

Alongside the cinematic preview, the giant screen outside Mannat also projected a deeply personal message penned by the actor himself. The handwritten note offered a direct expression of gratitude to the people who have supported his legendary career.

The displayed message read: 'To the hearts that made him KING, a lot of love in return.' This heartfelt acknowledgment further amplified the celebratory atmosphere surrounding his milestone 61st birthday.

Anticipation for Upcoming Projects

The festive celebrations arrived amid an intense wave of curiosity and growing anticipation surrounding the actor's cinematic slate. Chief among these upcoming projects is the film 'King', which pairs him once again with leading lady Deepika Padukone.

As one of the most eagerly awaited titles on the superstar's upcoming roster, the project has already generated massive online buzz, heightened further by the surprise preview unveiled during his birthday celebrations.

ld.articleBody:
Initial Reactions Surface

First reactions to the new heist thriller How to Rob a Bank have arrived, generating significant buzz among early viewers. Critics and reviewers have begun sharing their thoughts on the film, pointing to it as a major highlight in the cinematic landscape of 2026.

The early praise highlights a strong positive reception leading up to the movie's official theatrical rollout. Many have singled out the project as an unexpected delight that defies standard genre expectations.

Plot And Character Dynamics

The narrative follows a crew of bank robbers led by Ryan, a character portrayed by Nicholas Hoult. Instead of conducting traditional robberies in secret, the group chooses to livestream their heists and distribute the stolen funds to the public.

These criminal acts are driven by deep personal motivations, prompting a police investigation aided by a former thief named Emi, played by Anna Sawai. The dynamic between the characters adds layers of tension to the high-stakes operations.

Direction And Creative Vision

How to Rob a Bank is directed by David Leitch, whose previous work includes action features like Bullet Train and The Fall Guy. Reviewers noted that Leitch brings his signature kinetic energy to the project through fast-paced sequences.

Commentators described the film as a modern digital-age spin on classic tropes, drawing comparisons to a social-media-driven generation of fast-paced action franchises. Some even likened its thematic blend to Point Break meeting The Big Short.

Cast Performances And Standouts

Nicholas Hoult earned considerable acclaim for his compelling lead performance as Ryan, with some reviewers calling him a generational movie star. Alongside Hoult, the film features performances from Anna Sawai, Pete Davidson, and a buddy cop dynamic featuring John C. Reilly and Zoë Kravitz.

Several critics highlighted Pete Davidson and Anna Sawai as standout performers who added substantial emotional weight and memorable energy to the overall cinematic experience.

Thematic Elements And Social Commentary

Beyond the practical stunts and shootouts, the movie tackles contemporary societal issues and digital culture. Reviewers observed that the story addresses themes of viral fame, systemic inequality, and modern vigilante justice akin to a Robin Hood tale for the TikTok generation.

Some critics praised its surprising messaging regarding capitalist frustrations, while others felt the narrative occasionally leaned into tired genre clichés during its latter half.

Mixed Critique And Genre Tropes

Despite widespread enthusiasm for its style and energy, not all feedback was entirely unreserved. A few reviewers noted that character writing suffered in places, leading the second half of the film to rely heavily on predictable heist tropes.

Despite minor complaints regarding plotting and underdeveloped characters, the general consensus points to a stylish, high-octane thrill ride that leaves a strong lasting impression.

First reactions for the upcoming heist thriller How to Rob a Bank have praised its high-octane action, social media spin, and strong performances from a cast led by Nicholas Hoult. Directed by David Leitch, the film is scheduled for theatrical release on November 13, 2026.

The Golden Age of 1990s Cinematic Thrillers

The 1990s stands out as a remarkably vibrant era for film enthusiasts, offering an unforgettable mix of summer blockbusters, acclaimed dramas, and boundary-pushing genre pieces. While every cinematic category enjoyed significant growth and success during this decade, the thriller genre truly dominated the landscape. It delivered some of the most riveting, tense, and endlessly rewatchable masterpieces in film history, keeping audiences thoroughly gripped.

From chilling psychological dread to explosive cat-and-mouse games, the decade's top thrillers established a high benchmark for suspense. Directors and writers found innovative ways to play with audience expectations, utilizing unreliable narrators, high-stakes heists, and claustrophobic settings. These enduring classics continue to resonate with viewers generations later, cementing the 1990s as a pinnacle of cinematic achievement.

The Usual Suspects and Its Deceptive Narrative

Released during the remarkably productive year of 1995, director Bryan Singer's The Usual Suspects remains one of the most unpredictable and celebrated mystery-crime features of the era. The plot centers on the sole survivor of a disastrous drug deal who recounts how a group of notorious criminals assembled for a series of jobs, only to cross paths with a legendary underworld figure named Keyser Söze.

Starring an impressive ensemble that includes Chazz Palminteri, Gabriel Byrne, and Kevin Spacey, the film relies heavily on an unreliable perspective. Viewers must actively sift through details to separate truth from deception, leading up to one of the most satisfying and shocking twist endings in cinema history.

High-Stakes Action and Tactics in Heat

Another standout release from 1995, Michael Mann's Heat delivered some of the most pulse-pounding, gun-heavy action ever captured on film. The narrative follows a dedicated Los Angeles detective tracking a highly professional crew of robbers as they execute a series of daring heists before a crucial mistake threatens to bring the law down on them.

Led by legendary heavyweights Al Pacino, Robert De Niro, and the late Val Kilmer, the movie serves as a masterclass in tension and pacing. Featuring exceptionally realistic gunfight sequences and a brilliant cat-and-mouse dynamic, Heat stands as a defining action thriller of the decade.

Psychological Terror in Rob Reiner's Misery

Kicking off the decade on a terrifying note, Misery brought Stephen King's chilling novel to the big screen under the direction of the late Rob Reiner. The story follows acclaimed novelist Paul Shelton, who suffers severe injuries in a car crash and is rescued by Annie Wilkes, a self-proclaimed number one fan who nurses him in a secluded home.

Featuring powerful performances by the late James Caan and Kathy Bates, the film quickly turns into a harrowing hostage scenario when the protagonist realizes his caretaker has no intention of letting him leave. Bates delivered a groundbreaking, Academy Award-winning performance that solidified the project as a timeless horror-thriller staple.

The Lasting Legacy of '90s Suspense

The enduring appeal of these 1990s thrillers lies in their meticulous craftsmanship, unforgettable characters, and airtight pacing. Filmmakers of the era mastered the art of mounting dread and keeping viewers guessing until the final frame, utilizing practical effects, strong ensemble casts, and sharply written screenplays.

Decades after their initial theatrical runs, these pictures continue to influence modern filmmakers and captivate new generations of moviegoers. They represent a time when cinematic storytelling prioritized deep psychological tension and intricate plotting above all else.

ld.articleBody:
Passing Of A Screen Legend

The entertainment world is mourning the loss of veteran British performer Patrick Stewart, who has died at the age of 86. His family officially confirmed the news, noting that he passed away on October 28 at his home in Los Angeles. His wife, singer-songwriter Sunny Ozell, remained by his side during his final moments.

A public statement released via his social media channels on October 29 revealed that he had been managing Alzheimer's disease and Lewy body dementia. The family shared details about his brief battle with the illness and expressed gratitude for the dedicated care provided by Sunny throughout his sickness.

Early Life And Roots In Yorkshire

Born on July 13, 1940, in Mirfield, Yorkshire, the actor grew up far away from the glitz of the entertainment industry and experienced a challenging childhood. His passion for performance sparked during his school years when an educator introduced him to William Shakespeare's famous play The Merchant of Venice.

Before achieving global recognition on television and in blockbuster films, he spent years refining his craft on the stage. He dedicated fourteen years to the Royal Shakespeare Company, building a strong theatrical foundation that defined his early career.

Bollywood icon Salman Khan has once again demonstrated his reputation for generosity by hosting an exclusive private party for the cast and crew of his upcoming film. Gathered at his Panvel farmhouse, the team expected a standard meeting to discuss ongoing promotional strategies.

Instead, the agenda shifted entirely when the actor unveiled a major surprise, transforming the professional get-together into a celebratory evening to honor the hard work put into the project.

Luxury Swiss Timepieces as Tokens of Appreciation

The highlight of the evening was the distribution of high-end luxury Swiss watches to everyone involved in the production. Reports indicate that roughly twenty to twenty-five watches were handed out personally by the lead star.

Each timepiece was valued between Rs 2 lakh and Rs 6 lakh. Photographs from the special gathering quickly circulated online, offering fans a glimpse into the celebratory atmosphere at the farmhouse.

Demonstrating attention to detail, Salman Khan reportedly selected different luxury brands tailored specifically for the men and women on the project team. He made sure to hand out the expensive presents personally.

This gesture was aimed at acknowledging the dedication and grueling hours the team invested to bring the war drama from script to screen.

Key Cast and Crew in Attendance

Several notable members of the film's team were present at the Panvel gathering to enjoy the festivities and receive their gifts. Attendees included director Apoorva Lakhia and lead actress Chitrangda Singh.

Other cast and crew members present at the celebration were actors Ankur Bhatia, Vipin Bhardwaj, Tanya Desai, and dialogue writer Chintan Shah, many of whom shared moments from the party on social media.

The project serves as a major upcoming war drama starring Salman Khan and Chitrangda Singh, under the direction of Apoorva Lakhia. It is produced under the banner of Salman Khan Films.

Initially announced under the working title 'Battle of Galwan', the production later underwent a title change to its current moniker before locking in its theatrical launch.

Theatrical Release Timeline

The film's journey to the big screen experienced a few scheduling adjustments before settling on its final release date. Initially slated for a January arrival, the makers pushed the timeline.

The team finally settled on December 4, 2026, as the official date for the film to hit theatres nationwide, building anticipation among fans.

ld.articleBody:
The Long-Awaited Return

LE SSERAFIM made their much-anticipated comeback to the MAMA stage this weekend, performing on the second night of the ceremony. This appearance marked their first time participating in the event in three years, generating massive excitement among their supporters before the show began.

The group descended upon the Kyocera Dome in Japan on November 21 to deliver their grand return. Fans had eagerly awaited what the group would bring to the stage after years away from the program's lineup.

Stage Setup and Track Selections

For their opening number, the group performed "SAKI" featuring Aliyah's Interlude, taken from their second full album PUREFLOW pt.1. They subsequently transitioned into a special version of "SPAGHETTI," which featured j-hope of BTS.

Despite the heavy anticipation and the high-profile collaborations, the actual execution of the set failed to resonate universally with observers.

Awards Won During the Ceremony

Even though the performance faced criticism, the track "SPAGHETTI" proved successful in other ways during the night. The song earned the group a "Best Song Top 10" award alongside a trophy for "Best Collaboration."

However, these accolades did little to shield the group from the wave of negative attention that followed their time on stage.

Harsh Online Reactions

As video clips of the performance circulated widely across social media platforms, numerous K-Pop fans voiced sharp disapproval. Observers pointed to what they described as messy live vocals, while others directed criticism toward the song arrangements themselves.

The commentary quickly escalated online, with multiple users posting overwhelmingly harsh remarks and going so far as to label the appearance the worst performance the MAMA awards have ever witnessed.

Broader Award Show Controversy

The negative response to the performance followed an already controversial weekend for the group at the 2026 MAMAs. Prior to the stage critique, discussion had swirled around the "Best Female Group" category.

Although LE SSERAFIM had been widely predicted as the most likely contender to win, the award ultimately went to IVE, sparking accusations from viewers regarding the legitimacy of several wins during the ceremony.

ld.articleBody:
The Theatrical Exit of a Dark DC Experiment

The R-rated horror feature centered around the classic comic book villain has officially concluded its primary box-office run, exiting roughly one thousand theaters nationwide. Having reached the conclusion of its major milestones on the big screen, the film is preparing to transition to home viewing formats.

Industry tracking indicates that the picture will make its debut on digital platforms shortly after the first week of December. This scheduling leaves the production with approximately three weeks to capitalize on its remaining theater footprint before completing its theatrical life cycle.

Origins and Creative Shifts

The journey of this R-rated project to the silver screen involved several major creative transitions. Initially conceived as an offshoot of Matt Reeves' darker cinematic vision for the Dark Knight, the film originally had filmmaker Mike Flanagan attached to write and direct.

As studio strategies evolved, the production was absorbed into the broader DC Universe framework. Ultimately, direction of the feature fell to James Watkins, guiding the atmospheric horror story into a distinct corner of the comic book company's cinematic output.

Leadership Changes at DC Studios

The theatrical rollout of the horror spin-off occurred during a period of immense organizational transition for DC Studios. Just weeks after the film's premiere, shocking announcements revealed that co-CEOs James Gunn and Peter Safran had departed their posts after leading the division for four years.

This sudden shakeup has left the studio's carefully mapped future slate in a state of uncertainty. Observers note that the horror project was fortunate to secure a wide theatrical release given the turbulent climate surrounding the studio's overarching strategy.

Context Within the Broader Franchise Landscape

The cinematic landscape surrounding DC productions has seen diverse storytelling approaches flourish recently. Matt Reeves' universe expanded through a television series focusing on the Penguin, alongside plans for a direct sequel to his original Gotham-set feature.

Additionally, Todd Phillips pursued an independent continuity path with his standalone sequel focusing on another iconic villain. Prior to their departure, studio leadership emphasized that their long-term vision did not strictly depend on a rigid, interconnected cinematic universe.

Contrasting Past Cinematic Strategies

The previous era of DC filmmaking, often designated as the extended universe, frequently faced criticism for attempting to fast-track toward a massive ensemble crossover akin to rival comic adaptations. Those earlier efforts prioritized rapid expansion over individual character development.

With the recent departure of the studio's top executives, questions loom regarding whether the entire franchise will undergo yet another comprehensive reboot or if standalone storytelling will remain the preferred path forward.

ld.articleBody:
Third Friday Box Office Performance

The theatrical run of Ramayana Part One reached its third Friday with a collection of approximately Rs. 15 crore nett across the domestic market. Out of this daily sum, the Hindi version contributed Rs. 10.75 crore nett, while the various South-dubbed versions added another Rs. 4 crore nett to the overall tally.

This performance marked a 15 percent drop compared to the previous day, while the week-on-week decline proved to be rather steep at nearly 70 percent. Despite enjoying an open week devoid of major new theatrical competition, the film failed to maintain the flat or upward trajectory typically seen in larger urban centers on Fridays.

Overall Cume and Regional Milestones

With the latest figures added, the cumulative domestic box office collection for the Ranbir Kapoor and Yash starrer stands at Rs. 850 crore nett. While earlier projections anticipated an even higher lifetime trajectory, current trends indicate a likely final finish around the Rs. 750 crore nett mark as collections experience normal cooling.

Conversely, the regional performance in southern territories has been nothing short of historic. The South-dubbed versions officially crossed the major milestone of Rs. 200 crore nett, establishing a first-of-its-kind record for the industry. Specifically, Kerala has delivered a sensational run where the feature grossed over Rs. 60 crore within fifteen days, positioning it to potentially become the biggest non-Mollywood film in the state.

Circuit-Wise Breakdown Across India

Beyond Kerala, the movie has continued to pull impressive numbers in neighboring states, surpassing the Rs. 50 crore threshold in Tamil Nadu while marching steadily toward a Rs. 150 crore milestone in Karnataka. These robust southern tallies have heavily bolstered the overall box office health during a period when northern circuits witnessed softer numbers.

Despite its massive scale, the feature experienced relative underperformance within the Hindi heartland circuits. Industry analysts noted the irony of this trend, given that these particular regions are traditionally expected to serve as primary strongholds for a cinematic adaptation centered on the epic of Ramayana.

Footfalls and Pricing Concerns

An analysis of total footfalls reveals a more challenging underlying picture, with the overall ticket counts barely pushing past two crores over the span of two weeks. Observers point out that aggressive ticket pricing models throughout the year have created an inflated baseline on weekdays, which ultimately eliminated the traditional weekend bump in ticket sales that helps drive higher overall occupancies.

Furthermore, experts suggest that high admission prices have increasingly become a deterrent for casual moviegoers, preventing the feature from fully capitalizing on its widespread appeal and generating the kind of repetitive viewing cycles needed to reach unprecedented blockbusting tiers.

Cultural Adaptation and Narrative Style

The softer performance in specific northern segments has also been attributed to a shift in narrative tone. For generations, audiences have predominantly engaged with the Ramayana through television serials that heavily emphasized emotional depth and traditional melodrama.

In contrast, this cinematic iteration adopted a grand, Hollywood-style visual spectacle. While visually ambitious, this stylistic departure may have created a disconnect with traditional viewers who sought a more familiar emotional cadence from the storytelling.

External Challenges and Marketing Factors

Additional headwinds included persistent negativity surrounding the production over the course of the preceding year. Observers noted that these recurring criticisms inevitably weighed down public sentiment, especially given that the official marketing campaign remained relatively subdued and failed to mount a robust counter-narrative.

The combination of these compounding factors meant that while the project's financial status remains solidly in blockbuster territory, its ultimate commercial footprint fell somewhat short of the monumental potential expected from a venture of this magnitude.

While southern markets like Kerala and Karnataka delivered record-breaking tallies, overall growth was impacted by steep weekday-to-weekend trends, high ticket pricing strategies, and differing audience expectations regarding the epic's narrative presentation.

ld.articleBody:
The Return of Nitesh Tiwari

After maintaining silence for a span of six years, acclaimed filmmaker Nitesh Tiwari has made a triumphant comeback to the silver screen with his massive theatrical release, Ramayana. The cinematic spectacle enjoyed a robust opening week at the domestic box office before hitting top gear during its second weekend in theaters.

This tremendous momentum culminated on the tenth day of its theatrical run when the magnum opus officially crossed the monumental 700 crore net collection club in India. The extraordinary commercial performance has directly elevated the director's standing within industry leaderboards.

Understanding the Koimoi Director Ranking System

The Koimoi Directors' Ranking evaluates filmmakers based on the box office milestones achieved by their Hindi and Bollywood cinematic ventures within prestigious domestic clubs. Directors receive 100 points for a film entering the 100-crore club, 200 points for the 200-crore club, and corresponding points for higher tiers.

Additionally, filmmakers earn an extra 50 points for each feature film that secures a spot among the top ten overseas grossers. For films originating from South India, only the earnings generated by their respective Hindi-dubbed versions are factored into the scoring system.

Point Breakdown and Overseas Success

Prior to the grand premiere of Ramayana, Nitesh Tiwari held a respectable standing with a tally of 450 points. With his newest creation smashing past the 700 crore net mark domestically, he was immediately credited with 700 points for that specific tier.

Furthermore, an additional 50 points were granted because the movie successfully cracked the top 10 Bollywood grossers in international overseas markets. This brought his cumulative overall score to an impressive 1200 points.

Surpassing Industry Peers

Accumulating a total of 1200 points allowed Nitesh Tiwari to leapfrog filmmaker Siddharth Anand, who holds 1150 points. This strategic shift in the rankings places Tiwari securely in the coveted third position among elite directors.

Given the remarkable and steady trajectory of Ramayana at ticket counters everywhere, analysts project that Tiwari might soon challenge Rohit Shetty's tally of 1450 points. Meanwhile, Aditya Dhar continues to maintain a strong lead with 2200 points.

A Legacy Built on Blockbusters

Nitesh Tiwari's current ranking is supported by a strong portfolio of commercially successful movies across different milestones. His points breakdown includes one film in the 100 crore club with Chhichhore yielding 100 points.

He also secured 300 points from his blockbuster hit Dangal in the 300 crore club, alongside the 700 points from Ramayana, complemented by two films featuring in Bollywood's top 10 overseas grossers list.

Filmmaker Nitesh Tiwari has reached the top 3 of the Koimoi Director Ranking with a total of 1200 points after his latest feature Ramayana surpassed 700 crore net at the domestic box office. ld.articleBody:
A New Framework After Decades

The Central Board of Film Certification has rolled out a fresh set of guidelines for public film exhibition in India. Issued via the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, this updated rulebook effectively replaces the previous framework that had been in active service since December 1991.

The revised regulations delineate strict parameters regarding what can be showcased on screen, focusing closely on violence, substance use, sexual depictions, and the treatment of children, women, and animals. Simultaneously, the authorities have emphasized the ongoing need to safeguard creative freedom and ensure certification keeps pace with modern societal values.

Scrutiny on Violence and Crime

Under the revised regulations, films are explicitly cautioned against glorifying or justifying anti-social activities and criminal behavior. The board is instructed to keep a vigilant eye on unnecessary horror, cruelty, and graphic violence included primarily for shock value.

While creators are still permitted to explore complex or disturbing themes, the content must serve a genuine narrative purpose rather than desensitizing audiences to human suffering or demonstrating actionable methods for committing offences.

Protecting Vulnerable Groups and Women

The updated guidelines place specific emphasis on the depiction of vulnerable populations, prohibiting the needless involvement of children in violent scenarios or instances of child abuse. Cruelty toward animals and the mockery of individuals with physical or mental disabilities are also strictly barred.

Regarding the representation of women, the rules dictate that degradation and denigration are completely unacceptable. Graphic details of sexual violence, including rape, attempted rape, and molestation, should be avoided unless absolutely vital to the story, in which case they must be kept to a bare minimum.

Mandatory Drug Warnings and Substance Rules

An important addition involves strict protocols for narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances. Any film displaying the consumption or trafficking of such substances must feature a prominent statutory warning reading, Illicit Narcotics Destroy Health and Guarantees Imprisonment. Say No to Drugs.

Similar restrictions apply to alcohol and tobacco, prohibiting any framing that glamorizes or encourages smoking and drinking, drawing a firm line between a realistic depiction of these habits and their active promotion.

Religion, Communities, and National Security

The guidelines enforce rigorous standards concerning communal harmony, religious representation, and national importance. Content that generates contempt toward specific racial or religious groups, or promotes anti-national and anti-scientific attitudes, is heavily restricted.

Furthermore, films must refrain from challenging India's sovereignty, threatening public order, or undermining the dignity of the judiciary. The utilization of national symbols must strictly adhere to the Emblems and Names Prevention of Improper Use Act of 1950.

Age Classifications and Holistic Assessment

The age-based tier system remains intact, incorporating U/A 7+, U/A 13+, and U/A 16+ categories to assist parental supervision, alongside restrictions limiting certain features strictly to adult audiences or specialized professional viewers.

Crucially, the board has been directed to evaluate films as a complete entity rather than judging isolated scenes, taking into account contemporary standards and the specific historical periods portrayed within period dramas.

ld.articleBody:
Passing of Dr. Ram Hingorani

Dr. Ram Hingorani, the maternal grandfather of prominent Bollywood star Ranveer Singh, has passed away at the age of 96. The somber news was made public by the actor's cousin, Saumya Hingorani Thackeray, through an emotional post on social media.

The family has celebrated his exceptionally long life rather than solely focusing on the sorrow of his departure. At ninety-six years of age, he lived a full and vibrant life that left a lasting impact on his relatives and those close to him.

Timing and Final Moments

According to the family announcements, Dr. Hingorani passed away during a particularly symbolic and auspicious time. His death occurred on Diwali during the sacred hours of Lakshmi Puja.

Saumya Hingorani Thackeray described his final moments as peaceful. She noted that he chose the golden hour of the festival to depart, imagining that he has now gone home to reunite with his late wife.

Heartfelt Family Tributes

Family members took to digital platforms to share fond memories, old photographs, and entertaining videos capturing moments from Dr. Hingorani's life. Saumya praised him as the greatest grandfather in the world, thanking him for the shared moments.

The heartfelt tributes also featured lighthearted remarks imagining the senior Hingorani enjoying a crisp whiskey with his late wife, alongside affectionate requests to save a scoop of ice cream for future reunions.

Special Bond with Ranveer Singh

Ranveer Singh shared a famously close and playful bond with his maternal grandfather, whom he affectionately referred to as 'Nana-G'. Over the years, the actor posted several memorable glimpses of their relationship for his followers.

In August 2020, Ranveer posted a striking photograph of his grandfather wearing a Gucci cap, oversized sunglasses, and a gold chain, showcasing the senior Hingorani's youthful and vibrant personality.

Promotional Appearances and Viral Moments

Dr. Hingorani famously captured public attention during the promotional campaign for Ranveer Singh's 2023 feature film 'Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani'. At ninety-three years old, he participated in promotional videos that quickly won over fans.

In one memorable video clip, the grandfather and grandson danced together to the classic song 'Jhumka Gira Re' while Dr. Hingorani wore a 'team Rocky' T-shirt. Another video featured him delivering a humorous line about tequila.

Outpouring of Condolences

Following the announcement of his demise, social media users and fans flooded the family's posts with messages of sympathy and support. Many commentators directly addressed Ranveer Singh, acknowledging the well-known closeness of his bond with his grandfather.

Supporters offered love and strength to the entire family during this emotional period of saying goodbye, noting how fortunate the grandfather was to witness Ranveer's journey in the entertainment industry.

Support from South Indian Stars

As the highly anticipated theatrical release approaches, several prominent figures from the film industry have come forward to back the massive mythological project. Actor Allu Arjun took to social media to urge fans and audiences to support the movie, emphasizing that it transcends a regular cinematic experience. He described the project as a vital representation of Indian culture and an ambitious effort to elevate the overall standard of Indian cinema.

In his public message, Allu Arjun encouraged everyone to rally behind the creation, noting that it highlights native stories and national heritage. Kannada actor Rishab Shetty similarly expressed his admiration for the undertaking. He highlighted the unique impact of witnessing ancient narratives brought to life on such an expansive canvas, calling it a moment of immense pride for the entire national film fraternity.

Cast and Creative Vision

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the grand two-part epic features a high-profile ensemble cast portraying legendary characters. Ranbir Kapoor stars as Lord Ram, with Sai Pallavi stepping into the role of Sita and Yash appearing as Ravan. Additionally, Sunny देओल takes on the part of Hanuman, while Ravi Dubey portrays Lakshman.

The production is backed by producers Namit Malhotra and Yash, bringing together top-tier creative talent. The musical score for the ambitious venture is composed by the renowned duo of A.R. Rahman and Hans Zimmer, ensuring a grand auditory experience to match the visual scale.

Personal Reactions and Family Sentiments

Bollywood actor Arjun Rampal also shared his excitement for the premiere, recounting a touching moment involving his young son. He revealed that his son brought home an idol of Lord Ram and declared him a favorite new superhero. Rampal expressed profound pride as an artist, noting his anticipation of experiencing the grand spectacle alongside his family.

Meanwhile, musician Badshah was also reported to have shared an emotional reaction online after viewing the feature. The outpouring of positive sentiments from industry peers highlights the massive anticipation surrounding the mythological adaptation as it prepares for its worldwide audience.

The project has been generating substantial buzz internationally, having recently held a well-received premiere at the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures in Los Angeles. Following the screening, the film received favorable initial responses, paving the way for strong momentum in its advance booking phase.

Domestic pre-sales gained significant traction leading up to the opening weekend. Reports indicate that advance bookings crossed notable milestones, with a substantial portion of the earnings coming directly from opening-day ticket reservations across various theaters.

Ticketing Delays in Domestic Markets

Despite immense enthusiasm from moviegoers, the rollout of ticket sales in domestic theaters faced unexpected hurdles. While international audiences enjoyed immediate access to pre-sales following Dussehra on October 15, ticket availability in India was delayed.

The delay was primarily caused by ongoing discussions and disagreements between film distributors and theater owners regarding revenue-sharing models. As a result, domestic viewers had to wait until approximately five days before the official premiere to secure their seats.

ld.articleBody:
The OTT Premiere Announcement

Curry Barker's widely acclaimed feature film Obsession is scheduled to arrive on digital platforms via The Peacock Hub on JioHotstar. The streaming release date is locked for October 30, bringing the major international hit to smaller screens following an impressive theatrical run.

A Desi Twist for the Digital Debut

To cater to local audiences, the streaming release features a special Hindi-dubbed version. Prominent Bollywood stars Kriti Sanon and Varun Dhawan have stepped in to provide the voice acting for the central characters in this localized adaptation.

Voice Cast Assignments

In this Hindi interpretation of the global hit, actress Kriti Sanon has lent her voice to the character of Nikki. Meanwhile, her co-star Varun Dhawan has dubbed the dialogue for the character of Bear.

Global Success and Original Cast

The theatrical version of the movie achieved massive commercial milestones, crossing half a billion dollars in collections worldwide. The original English language edition stars Inde Navarrette and Michael Johnston, whose performances drove the film's international triumph.

Kriti Sanon Shares Her Dubbing Experience

Kriti expressed great enthusiasm for the gripping and quirky nature of the project. She noted that she has never tackled such an edgy persona before, making this voice-acting debut for another actor's performance a uniquely challenging and enjoyable milestone.

Varun Dhawan's Perspective on the Project

Varun revealed that participating in the Hindi dub allowed him to appreciate the movie on a deeper level. Working closely with the material helped him notice subtle narrative details that he might have overlooked during an initial viewing.

Reuniting Past Co-Stars

This latest creative partnership marks another collaboration between Kriti Sanon and Varun Dhawan. The duo previously worked together on the silver screen in popular Bollywood titles including Dilwale and Bhediya.

The international hit, which originally starred Inde Navarrette and Michael Johnston, brings the actors back together following their earlier collaborations in Dilwale and Bhediya.
